assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: A 5 by 5 grid with the dashed vertical line x = 5/2; a blue shortest route from (0,0) to (5,5) and a red dashed route from (5,0) to (0,5) both cross the middle column on the same horizontal segment at height 2, where a black dot marks the collision point.

difficulty_rationale: The key insight is that meetings can only happen at half-integer times on the middle column, reducing the problem to comparing crossing heights.
